# Albertine Couture Hair Salon

> Black-owned, woman-owned full-service hair salon in the DMV with two locations, open 24/7 (walk-ins daily from 5 AM; after-hours by appointment). Owner: Albertine (15+ years). Braids of every kind, twists, locs and micro locs, sew-ins and wigs, K-tip and I-tip extensions, silk press, color and cuts for women, men and kids.

- Gaithersburg, MD: 305 Muddy Branch Rd, Gaithersburg, MD 20878 (Festival at Muddy Branch) · (301) 765-4915
- Dumfries, VA: 17457 Jefferson Davis Hwy, Dumfries, VA 22026 · (571) 409-8230 (call or text)
- Instagram: @albertinecouturehairsalon · TikTok: @albertinecoutuhairsalon
- Services & prices: /services · Price Finder: /style-finder · Book: /book
